title: person.erased.v1
description: Published when an erasure request has purged a person. Consumers delete or anonymise their own copies keyed by `party_id`. No personal data is included. Delivered at least once; consumers de-duplicate on `id`. The payload carries opaque ids and machine values only, never names, contact data or free text (SPEC.md sections 3.7 and 4.3).

id.description: Unique event id, stable across redeliveries.
